payload.reason: Record the decision to switch SMS reminders to Sinch and replace the Vonage stop decision.

payload.body: Vonage experiences failures on Portuguese numbers; decision: migrate SMS reminders to Sinch starting 1 November. Vonage rollout is decommissioned. This replaces the earlier decision to stop the Vonage rollout.

payload.body: Owner: Priya; Redesign SMS templates for Sinch integration. Due date: 2026-10-30.

payload.reason: Operational decision to simplify analytics hosting while keeping data in EU.

payload.body: Self-hosting PostHog is consuming too much ops time. Switch to PostHog Cloud (EU region) so clinic data remains in the EU.
